API_KEY_IN_URL: Send the API key in the Authorization header, not in the address.
API_KEY_REQUIRED: Create an API key before allowing access from other computers.
BENCHMARK_UNSUPPORTED: Benchmarks aren't available on this computer.
COMPUTER_OFFLINE: The computer running this model is offline.
CONNECTION_LOST: The connection to the model was lost.
CONTEXT_TOO_LONG: This chat is too long for the model.
EXTERNAL_BAD_URL: The base URL must start with http:// or https://, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.
EXTERNAL_LOCAL_ONLY: This chat uses memories or knowledge marked This computer only, so it can't go to the external server. Choose a model on this computer.
EXTERNAL_OFFLINE_PROFILE: This profile keeps work on this computer, so it doesn't use the external server. Choose a model on this computer or another profile.
HARDWARE_DETECT_FAILED: Yggdrasil couldn't fully detect this computer's hardware. Some details may be missing.
INVALID_LOCALE: That isn't a language Yggdrasil recognizes.
INVALID_RATING: A rating is 1 to 5 stars, with reasons from the list.
JOIN_NOT_REACHABLE: Other computers can't reach this one. Turn on Find other computers, then restart Yggdrasil.
JOIN_OTHER_NETWORK: This computer is already in another Yggdrasil network. Run toskarctl leave first to join this one.
JOIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many join attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.
JOIN_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This join token has expired. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_INVALID: This join token isn't valid. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_NOT_ACTIVE: That join token can't be revoked: it was already used, revoked, or expired.
JOIN_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND: No join token has that ID.
JOIN_TOKEN_REVOKED: This join token was revoked. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_USED: This join token has already been used. Make a new join command for each computer.
JOIN_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach Yggdrasil at {{server}}. Check the address, the firewall, and that Yggdrasil is running there.
JOIN_WRONG_SERVER: The computer at that address isn't the one the join command was made on. Nothing that proves the token was sent.
LOG_NOT_FOUND: That log file couldn't be opened.
MCP_NOT_FOUND: There's no tool source with that name.
MEMORY_LOOKS_SECRET: That looks like a password, key, or token, so Yggdrasil didn't save it.
NEEDS_APPROVAL: This needs your approval before the automation can go on.
NO_MODEL_ASSIGNED: No model is chosen for this. Install one in Models, or choose one in the profile.
NO_MODEL_INSTALLED: No model is installed yet. Install one in Models to start chatting.
NO_TEXT_FOUND: No text found. Scanned PDFs need text recognition (OCR) before Yggdrasil can read them.
OUT_OF_MEMORY: The model ran out of memory.
PAIRING_RATE_LIMITED: Too many pairing attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and start pairing again.
PEER_TOO_OLD: That computer needs a newer Yggdrasil to run tools for others.
PREFERENCE_CANNOT_GRANT_TOOLS: Preferences and memories can't give permission to use tools. Change what tools may do in Settings → Tool permissions or in a profile.
RATINGS_UNREACHABLE: Your rating is saved on this computer, but the ratings service couldn't be reached. Try again later.
RATING_NOT_SHAREABLE: This model can't be compared with others' ratings, so its rating stays on this computer.
RUNTIME_ERROR: The model's engine ran into an error.
RUNTIME_NOT_INSTALLED: {{runtime}} isn't installed. Install it in Models.
RUN_NOT_FOUND: That run isn't recorded, or its record was removed.
SANDBOXED: This copy of Yggdrasil runs in the macOS App Sandbox, which can't run a Python environment it downloads.
SERVICE_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach the local Yggdrasil service ({{detail}}). If this is the desktop app, quit and reopen it so the service restarts.
SPEECH_NO_VOICE: There is no voice to read {{language}} aloud yet.
SUPPORT_MODEL_BUSY: The supporting model can't run right now.
TOOL_SOURCE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: That gallery entry or app setting wasn't found.
UNAUTHORIZED: This Yggdrasil needs an API key.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Yggdrasil can't read {{name}} yet. Attach a document, spreadsheet, PDF, code file, audio, or a PNG or JPEG image.
